warnings.message: The Invitation to Tender body specifies only short lot titles in Section 1 (Lots). Detailed lot scope, quantities, technical standards and product specifications are deferred to Appendix 1: Evaluation Criteria and the contract documents attached on ProContract, which are not present in this structural extraction. Downstream product-candidate matching should treat these lot descriptions as indicative only.

The ITT body does not assign CPV codes to individual lots. Notice-level CPV codes (44221300-8 Gates, 44400000-4 Miscellaneous fabricated products, 45223100-7 Assembly of metal structures) were available in process_context but not asserted in the document text; lots.cpv_codes left empty to avoid hallucinated per-lot attribution.

The document cites legal and procurement standards (Public Contracts Regulations 2015, Bribery Act 2010, Fraud Act 2006, GDPR/Data Protection Act 2018, Housing Grants Construction and Regeneration Act 1996, Living Wage Foundation rate, CLOCS, FORS, Equality Act 2010) but does not state any product-level technical standards (no BS/EN/ISO references). lots.technical_standards left empty.
Docling structural extraction records page_count=0 and all sections reported as page_start=1/page_end=1, so evidence anchors use section-name / markdown-region refs rather than true page numbers.

Lot 1 title appears only as a stray bullet in Section Four (1.1.1. Lot 1 - Repairs and/or modification to metal items) rather than in the Section One (Lots) enumeration, which begins at 1.1.2. Likely an OCR/flow artefact; the lot is treated as in-scope.
